g.text: Marketplace metrics: supply, demand, and the match between them
watch the balance: too much demand starves supply, and the reverse
economics: GMV, take rate (platform revenue / GMV), contribution margin per order
the reverse: too much supply starves suppliers of work
too much demand: waits rise and buyers churn
Uber / Ola: driver utilisation and rider wait time (ETA) are the balance pair;
surge pricing pulls supply in when demand outruns it
